title: The Mass Gap of Pure SU(N) Gauge Theory as a Finite-Aperture Effect
description:
The paper reads the mass gap of pure SU(N) Yang-Mills as a finite-aperture effect: the vacuum is read through a finite aperture, which band-limits, and the gap is the entropy margin Delta = kappa_0 - mu > 0 below the counting floor kappa_0 = (1/4) ln 3 -- a number COUNTED from directed cube paths, not fitted. Since pure Yang-Mills carries no dimensionful parameter, a fitted constant anywhere below the gap would be a smuggled scale, which is what makes the transmutation legitimate.

THE FORMAL STATUS. The development is sorry-free and the axiom footprint of every theorem is generated by the build rather than asserted, so the line between what is proved and what is still assumed is machine-checked and can be read off the artifact.

NEW IN THIS RELEASE. Reflection positivity is PROVED rather than cited, at even lattice extent at least four and nonnegative coupling, by an action split and a three-block Haar factorisation with no representation theory -- and on that domain the finite-aperture (ymModel) gap side carries NO named axiom at all. The correlation's symmetry on the lag circle is proved too, discharging an assumption the read's own construction had rested on. The substrate input of the finite-aperture route is reduced to a contact-relative power law on the plaquette correlation, and that law is then proved OUTRIGHT on a derived strong-coupling interval, carrying nothing; the weak-coupling remainder is what is left.

The repository holds the paper, the Lean 4 / Mathlib development, and the Entroptics analysis code.
